decision: ACCEPTED FOR THE AGREED FINAL PROJECT SCOPE
scope_authority: Project requester confirmed the revised final acceptance scope in this conversation on 25 October 2026.
assessment_method: Recorded live recommendation evidence, deterministic metric verification, native-code identity review and eight current-main offline compatibility tests.
accepted_scope: Dataset-supported structured recommendation behavior across 40 registered scenarios and their expected native statuses.
Frozen relevance judgments and Precision, judged-pool Recall and NDCG at K=1-10 for the recorded results.
Stored mandatory-condition and source-field consistency checks, sparse inventories, no-match controls and registered state updates.
Compatibility of the current saved-result display expansion, supported by eight local tests and 27 unchanged native ranking/contract/validation files.
scope_changes: The 60 difficult/complex cases are retained as a separate non-blocking stress study, outside the final acceptance gate.
External participant UAT, independent human relevance scoring and separate human signatures are not required under the revised protocol.
The previously frozen grades are adopted unchanged as the final reference labels for this submission.
retained_limitations: The source snapshot cannot verify every real-user criterion, current availability or whole-unit occupancy.
Recorded timeouts, semantic/schema validation, contract, provider and explanation failures remain technical observations; they are not all relabeled as dataset limitations or passes.
Pool Recall is not full-corpus Recall; the two cohorts use different recorded labeling methods.
No new full live end-to-end run, human study or empirical satisfaction claim is made by this acceptance decision.
Legacy sessions without a reserved tail may refresh from saved requirements. New returned identities in that branch need not equal a historical saved list.

github_publication_of_this_revision.integration_method: Pull request; branch publication does not assert a merge.
github_publication_of_this_revision.prior_evidence_publication: PRs 2, 3 and 5 merged; all historical raw evidence retained.
